label: WRONG
reason: Zod schemas in the schema files are all named *Schema (auth-router, folder-router, profile-router, webhook-router), but the only outlier, ZGenericSuccessResponse in server/schema.ts, is a plain response value ({success: true} satisfies the inferred type) and not a schema, so renaming it *Schema would be wrong. The group mixes schemas with other exported values (the exempted length constants are another such kind). 0 of 1 counted outliers is a mistake, so WRONG mixed_group. I hesitated with ACCEPT because the Z prefix on a non-schema value is odd in itself.
